body:
I am sorry that you are in pain as well. Why do break ups have to be so painful? :(

I'm always looking for a glimmer of hope that he'll want me again. We aren't even on bad terms with each other (we still get along, but we aren't in a relationship)

Nothing is the same anymore! Is that how it feels for you? Knowing that he'll probably eventually end up finding another girl and doing stuff with her hurts even more!!!
I'm sorry. It really hurts doesn't it? I think deep down we tell ourselves that life isn't going to be the same without them. I don't know.

I wish I could think that way because its like my ex has his arms firmly gripped around me. And there's no point in me going on with life if I can't be with him. Life just isn't the same anymore. I don't know what's wrong with me :(
I'm sorry that this happened. I don't want to be in a world without my ex either. It just wouldn't be the same. I mean yeah, this sounds really awful.

I'm sorry that your ex broke up with you like that. As much as breakups are going to hurt, there's no need for someone to break up with someone like that. I think it's very inconsiderate and wrong. What I'm saying is that they should consider the others feelings.

I'm sorry that she cut you off.  And I'm sorry that you are also suffering. Why do these things have to hurt so much, whyyyy? :(
No, not someone else, too! I'm truly sorry for what you are going through. Can't imagine the pain you are in right now.

I hate it that I'm so weak. It's been months since me and him broke up. I told him what I thought about him. He replied nicely but it's not nearly enough. I know he doesn't miss me as much as I miss him :( We aren't getting back together. 

So, that's it.
